dailyPage.title: BetInsight Daily
dailyPage.tagline: Your daily lucky number · Loyalty is rewarded
dailyPage.heading: Activate Your Lucky Number
dailyPage.intro: Start once per calendar day. Your next claim unlocks every day at 00:00 German time. Your streak gradually increases your loyalty level, and an additional loyalty box awaits on day 7.
dailyPage.notStartedCopy: The reels will stop one by one on your result.
dailyPage.serverNote: Your result is calculated server-side and credited as Gift Units.
dailyPage.ruleServerCopy: Make determines the result. The animation only displays the result that has already been decided.
dailyPage.rule24Copy: After your claim, Daily stays locked until 00:00 German time, regardless of when you clicked.
dailyPage.ruleGiftCopy: Daily bonuses are kept separately from purchased and Referral Units as Gift Units.
dailyPage.boxDay7Copy: An additional bonus for completing a full 7-day streak.
dailyPage.boxOpenedCopy: Your loyalty bonus has been credited to your Gift Units.
dailyPage.boxWaiting: Your loyalty box is waiting for you!
dailyPage.boxWaitingCopy: Open it now or later. It remains available until your next loyalty box.
dailyPage.todayUsedCopy: Your next claim unlocks automatically at 00:00 German time.
dailyPage.openFromProfile: Please open Daily from your BetInsight profile.
dailyPage.parallel: Your Daily Claim is currently being processed. Please wait a moment.
dailyPage.claimFailed: The Daily Claim could not be processed.
dailyPage.boxFailed: The loyalty box could not be opened right now.
dailyPage.goodLuck: 🍀 Good luck – your number is being drawn …
dailyPage.rollersStart: The reels are already running while your result is being calculated server-side.
dailyPage.responseError: The Daily response could not be processed right now. Please try again in a moment.
dailyPage.historyError: History could not be loaded right now.
dailyPage.historyProof: These entries come from the BetInsight server log, allowing the lucky number, bonus and booking time to be verified later.
